instruction: Candid outdoor full photograph of a grassy park with trees. In the foreground, the woman in the black beanie (R5) in a red t-shirt and blue jeans leans forward, pulling hard on a yellow rope. Behind her, the man in the red polo (R3) in a red polo and blue jeans crouches and pulls the rope with determination. The bald man (R2) is partially visible directly behind the woman, assisting in the pull. The group is aligned in a row, gripping the thick yellow rope in a game of tug-of-war. Soft, natural daylight filters through the trees, highlighting the natural green and red palette.
